instruction: Modular Housing Reclassification Pack This task starts from init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: init_plan.png, init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as result.txt, result.ifc, result.pdf. Export result.txt as a tab-delimited unit area schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes, and result.txt with size at least 20 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 4 IfcSpace entities. 5. The IFC model contains at least 8 IfcWall entities, at least 2 IfcSlab entities, and at least 2 IfcRoof entities. 6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: UNIT-1, UNIT-2, UNIT-3, UNIT-4. 7. UNIT-1, UNIT-2 are assigned to one storey; and UNIT-3, UNIT-4 are assigned to a second storey. 8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [12.0, 4.0, 6.6]. 9. Result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: UnitID, Area. 10. Result.txt has exactly 4 data rows in this order: UNIT-1 24.0, UNIT-2 24.0, UNIT-3 24.0, UNIT-4 24.0, with numeric values matching within tolerance +/-0.10. 11. Result.pdf has exactly 2 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A101, A201, MODULAR HOUSING RECLASSIFICATION PACK, UNIT-1, UNIT-4. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
